@Headers her istekte aynı başlıkları ekl: @Headers adds the same headers on every request; an @Header value is given at the call. httpbin echoes the headers it received.

Dart tek iş parçacığında çalışır: ekranı: Dart runs on one thread: the code that draws the screen and the button code share one queue. The gear below turns every frame; if a job locks the queue, the gear stops too.
Bütçe cihaz RAM'inin %2'si. %90'ı geçinc: The budget is 2% of the device RAM. Past 90%, or when Android says "low memory", images off screen are dropped; the ones on screen stay, so the picture does not flicker.
İnternet kontrolü bir kez sorulup bir ke: If the internet check is asked once and answered once, it is a Future; if you are told whenever the state changes, it is a Stream. When the connection drops, a warning (MaterialBanner) appears at the top of every page.
Servis bir arayüz olarak yazılır, istemc: The service is written as an interface, and build_runner generates the client. Tap a card, change the values, press Send: you see the object Retrofit returned and the raw request that crossed the network.
Süreler Stopwatch ile mikrosaniye (µs) h: Times are measured with a Stopwatch down to microseconds (µs); 1 ms = 1,000 µs. "From memory" rows never touch the disk, so they are very short; the real disk cost is in the "from disk" rows. Each measurement differs a little, so try a few times.
